title: 2831. Find the Longest Equal Subarray

examples.explanation: It's optimal to delete the elements at index 2 and index 4. After deleting them, nums becomes equal to [1, 3, 3, 3]. The longest equal subarray starts at i = 1 and ends at j = 3 with length equal to 3. It can be proven that no longer equal subarrays can be created.

It's optimal to delete the elements at index 2 and index 3. After deleting them, nums becomes equal to [1, 1, 1, 1]. The array itself is an equal subarray, so the answer is 4. It can be proven that no longer equal subarrays can be created.
